**Severity:** error · **Area:** Syntax / JSX / attributes (`RV1xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads one of:

```text
Unsupported parser-repaired native nesting: {tag}
```

```text
Unsupported parser-repaired native nesting: text in <{tag}>
```

```text
Unsupported parser-repaired native nesting: {inner} in <{tag}>
```

```text
Unsupported parser-repaired native nesting: rows directly in <table> get an implied <tbody> (wrap the For / Show / .map in <tbody>)
```

Parts in braces (`{name}`) are filled in for each report.

## How to fix

Use nesting the HTML parser keeps as written: no block elements inside `<p>` (use `<div>`), wrap table rows in `<tbody>`, only `<option>/<optgroup>` inside `<select>`.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
export const A = () => <p><div /></p>;
```

```tsx prefer
export const A = () => <div><div /></div>;
```

## When it is reported

Only the implied-`<tbody>` variant carries a hint; '`{tag}`' variant does not name the offending parent.
